title: A figure: a drawing that a module in the repo makes, tied to its source

module.description: The path of a JavaScript module, relative to the page or to the repo root. Its default export is { html, script?, css? }.

source.description: What the figure draws: `#<flow id>` or `<page>.md#<flow id>` for a flow diagram, or the path of a file.

illustration.description: true when the figure states no facts, so it has no source.
